{{Quote|Thirty-two hours ago, thieves raided a military storehouse. They stole weapons, supplies and data files for the Planet Prison project.|Agent [[Galen (SIS)|Galen]]|<ref name="Stolen Secrets" />}}
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] maintained a '''warehouse''' on the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Stolen Secrets" /> By [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> the Republic Military stored heavy weaponry and munitions at the warehouse, and the facility's [[Computer/Legends|computers]] had access to the design files for the [[Planet Prison]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], a group of thieves led by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Vistis Garn]] [[Raid on a Republic Military warehouse|raided]] the warehouse on behalf of the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]] and [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicates. The group sliced the warehouse's computers to steal the design files along with munitions, rockets, and heavy weaponry before retreating to the [[Old Galactic Market]], the area of Coruscant under the Guild's control. However, Garn's face was seen by [[Security camera/Legends|security cameras]], allowing the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]], the Republic's intelligence agency, to identify him and send a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] to [[Raid on the Migrant Merchants' Guild warehouse|recover]] the files and weaponry from the criminals.<ref name="Stolen Secrets" />

==Behind the scenes==
The warehouse is briefly mentioned in the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class mission "Stolen Secrets" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Stolen Secrets" />
